# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** 16 or 17 years old  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v2 c26 P44](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c26 P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is a plain, wholesome, and sensible-looking girl. As she grows into her late teens, she is described as a very nice, ladylike girl who possesses a neat and proper manner.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## Personality

Jane is neat, practical, and thoroughly sensible, with little inclination toward imagination, poetry, or sentiment. She is conscientious, industrious, and straightforward in her conduct and expectations. Though lacking in artistic or romantic tendencies, she is a loyal, reliable friend and holds firm, unemotional views on practical matters.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c13 P66](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0066)_

## Traits

- Practical and sensible  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>
- Conscientious and industrious  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- Unimaginative  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v2 c13 P66](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0066), [v2 c13 P72](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0072)</sub>
- Dislikes sentimental lovemaking in stories  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>

## Abilities

- Competent in domestic science  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- Skilled at practicing and singing music  <sub>[v1 c15 P76](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0076), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)</sub>

## Goals

- To earn her salary as a schoolteacher, satisfy her trustees, and be placed on the School Inspector's roll of honor  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>
- To devote her life to teaching without marrying  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Jane Andrews grew up in Avonlea as a classmate and friend of Anne Shirley and Diana Barry. She attended the local school under Mr. Phillips and later Miss Stacy, joining the Queen's class to prepare for a teaching license. During her school years, she participated in local events such as the Sunday School picnic, the Christmas concert, and the youth Story Club, where she was noted for writing sensible, non-romantic stories. She passed her Entrance Examinations successfully and attended Queen's Academy in Charlottetown, where she distinguished herself in the domestic science course and earned her Second Class teacher's license. After graduating, she accepted a position as teacher at the Newbridge school, and later took the school in Carmody when it became vacant.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)_

- Sister to Prissy, Billy, and Alice Andrews  <sub>[v1 c15 P76](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0076), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School and Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>
